strength: The orbit-as-clock rotation is a fresh, skill-rich core: strategic bot beats random by 77.7 points and the game runs cleanly with no ties or stuck games.
weakness: The two win conditions are not co-equal and the split flips with player count (2p 72/28 Star, 4p 39/61, 6p 25/75), together with HP-dominated Star strength and 40 open rule gaps; these are mostly owner decisions on the locked rules.

closest_existing_game.name: Orbita (2025); nearest in feel is CCG duels

required_changes: Re-cost or lower AE28 and AE25 (3-damage hard-cost cards); target winning link under 0.2
Add 4-6 cheap knockout/Size-reduction AEs including 1 Denial card; target CM cancel share 45-55% and a higher CM share at 2p
Give rotation-trick cards (AE41, AE43, AE45, AE55, AE57, AE60, CO14, CO24) clear payoffs; target each played in at least 5% of games
After the owner rules on G4, G7, G8, G10, G12/13, G27, G29, re-run on the locked readings; target seat gap 5 or less
Replace 2-3 always-dead AEs with cards playable on an empty board; target under 3 dead cards per 7-card hand
revision_reason: Yes, once the owner answers G4, win-path scaling and the key rule gaps; card fixes are cheap with a clear diagnosis, but without those answers a revision re-measures an unsettled rule set.
